label: What happens when a text is performed

blocks.text: This process involved finding the right voice for each text: maybe a more bureaucratic and strict tone for the juvenile judge, and a tone of voice that matched the age of the character.
"I was always trying to create a varied picture of vocal intentions and effects. A dry institutional report, for example, had to be a monotone experience." — Ari

"Sentences that appear bureaucratically neutral on the page may sound deeply violent once spoken aloud. [...] Should institutional reports sound cold and distant, or hesitant and uncertain? Where should silence enter?" — Naomi
